recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is. Revisit only if FHIR-I reopens the package guidance and explicitly supersedes the final FHIR-41622 resolution with new xver wording.
issue_request: FHIR-41622 is an Applied/Persuasive, non-substantive FHIR-I correction against the FHIR-core versioning page. It asked to fix the package id shown for version-specific StructureDefinition URLs; the final Jira resolution changed hl7.fhir.r{x}.core{x} / hl7.fhir.r4.core4 to hl7.fhir.r{x}.core / hl7.fhir.r4.core.
initial_application: The source fix was applied by git commit 5475dc947013dea1bd8d227d522b334f4f115c33, whose subject is FHIR-41622 and which changed source/versioning.html from the old core{x}/core4 package example to the resolved core package example. The 2025-11-02 Jira comment links PR HL7/fhir#3898, matching that application path.
additional_context: The reporter's initial Zulip/Jira comment suggested hl7.fhir.xver.r4, but the final Jira resolution and FHIR-I 2023-12-11 minutes record a Persuasive 7-0-0 decision for FHIR-41622 with resolution text choosing hl7.fhir.r{x}.core. The page is current build-scope source because publish.ini lists versioning.html and source/hierarchy.xml links it as Managing Multiple FHIR Versions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/versioning.html already says the URLs are found in package hl7.fhir.r{x}.core, e.g. hl7.fhir.r4.core, and source grep found no remaining hl7.fhir.r{x}.core{x} or hl7.fhir.r4.core4 text.
